name: CHIRPS Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations
description: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) is a quasi-global (50°S–50°N, all longitudes) rainfall dataset spanning 1981 to near-present at 0.05° (~5 km) spatial resolution. Developed by the Climate Hazards Center at UC Santa Barbara in collaboration with the USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center, CHIRPS merges satellite cold cloud duration (CCD) thermal infrared observations, long-term CHPclim climatologies, and in-situ ground precipitation station observations to provide robust daily, pentadal, and monthly precipitation estimates for drought monitoring and humanitarian early warning.
